patch.description: The slug moves with the name, so every URL and container name under the stack moves too. Swarm cannot rename a service, so running tiles are stopped under the old name and redeployed under the new one. Volumes, databases and history are keyed by id and survive. A config-managed stack is refused: its file owns the name.
